name: Evidence audit
description: Audit a numeric claim against locally saved source evidence, including denominator and reproducible calculations, before citing or publishing it.
author: Undominated.ai
whenToUse: Audit a numeric claim against locally saved source evidence, including denominator and reproducible calculations, before citing or publishing it.
limitations: Deterministic local checks over supplied evidence; not a guarantee of source truth or production suitability.

author: Undominated.ai
whenToUse: Verify local release artifacts and meaningful public-response receipts without confusing a build, HTTP 200 or registry metadata with a working installation.

name: Evidence reviewer
description: Independently challenge numerical claims using source identity, denominator reconstruction and repeatable calculations.
author: Undominated.ai
whenToUse: Review a pricing headline, model comparison, benchmark conclusion or externally sourced resource claim before it is repeated.
limitations: Portable profile; manually load or adapt to a native agent format. No automatic subagent registration or permission grants.

name: Model migration planner
description: Plan workload-specific model migrations while preserving required capabilities and defining observable rollback criteria.
author: Undominated.ai
whenToUse: A team wants to replace a model or provider for cost, latency, capability or availability reasons.
limitations: Portable profile; manually load or adapt to a native agent format. No automatic subagent registration or permission grants.

name: AI resource curator
description: Review skills, agents and MCP servers against a concrete use case, with pinned identity, rights and runtime evidence.
author: Undominated.ai
whenToUse: A collection or team needs a justified addition, a replacement for an obsolete resource, or an installation review.
limitations: Portable profile; manually load or adapt to a native agent format. No automatic subagent registration or permission grants.

name: Resource release verifier
description: Independently verify packaged resources, clean installation and meaningful public availability after a release.
author: Undominated.ai
whenToUse: A package, skill repository, download or website change is about to be described as shipped or installable.
limitations: Portable profile; manually load or adapt to a native agent format. No automatic subagent registration or permission grants.

name: Seller-spread audit
description: Check a price-spread multiple against distinct seller owners, so one vendor's own service tiers are not counted as competition.
author: Undominated.ai
whenToUse: Check a price-spread multiple against distinct seller owners, so one vendor's own service tiers are not counted as competition.
limitations: Deterministic local checks over supplied rows and caller-assigned seller owners; not a guarantee of source truth or market coverage.

name: Dominance wording audit
description: Classify a two-model comparison before publishing it, so a tie or a dropped requirement is not called both better and cheaper.
author: Undominated.ai
whenToUse: Classify a two-model comparison before publishing it, so a tie or a dropped requirement is not called both better and cheaper.
limitations: Deterministic local checks over one supplied pair and the listed requirements; not a guarantee of source truth.

name: Plan-quote hygiene
description: Keep unverified subscription quotes out of a USD monthly ceiling. A source sentence is not a price.
author: Undominated.ai
whenToUse: Keep unverified subscription quotes out of a USD monthly ceiling. A source sentence is not a price.
limitations: Deterministic local checks over a supplied plan table; not a guarantee that a vendor page still matches.

name: Licence-boundary audit
description: Check a redistribution claim against the licence evidence you recorded. A public page is not a licence.
author: Undominated.ai
whenToUse: Check a redistribution claim against the licence evidence you recorded. A public page is not a licence.
limitations: Deterministic consistency check of a filled licence note; it does not interpret licence text or fetch the licence.

name: Context-tier ladder audit
description: Check a past-this-length price multiple against every rung, so the dearest rung is not applied at the first boundary.
author: Undominated.ai
whenToUse: A headline says a model becomes N times dearer past one input length.
limitations: Deterministic local check of a supplied ladder; it does not fetch vendor prices or model marginal block billing.

name: Comparison editor
description: Edit model-comparison copy so ties, same-seller tiers and dropped requirements are not published as dominance.
author: Undominated.ai
whenToUse: A headline, table caption, FAQ or badge is about to say one model is better and cheaper, or that a price spread measures competition.
limitations: Portable profile; manually load or adapt to a native agent format. No automatic subagent registration or permission grants.

name: Pricing source reviewer
description: Review a provider price feed before any rate is admitted, including units, currency, tiers and prose quotes that are not USD.
author: Undominated.ai
whenToUse: A new provider catalogue, a changed billing page, or a subscription total is proposed for publication.
limitations: Portable profile; manually load or adapt to a native agent format. No automatic subagent registration or permission grants.

name: Undominated MCP server
description: Read-only local MCP server for published model verdicts and resource discovery.
author: Undominated.ai
limitations: Host configuration import is manual; installing does not run or register the server. Data tool availability depends on published endpoints.
